"""Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (sdh-spot-check): raw R(B) first, then onset + 1/B FFT vs F_L and the model."""
import warnings
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset

# Model reference (hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count/fs_count_b0.py, u_D = 0, run from hera_scratch/): F in T
MODEL = {+3.2: dict(ABAB=(7.31, 25.78), ABCA=33.09), -1.2: dict(ABAB=(5.86, 6.54), ABCA=12.41)}
SPOTS = [(6, +3.2, 1.0), (7, -1.2, 0.3)]    # (run, n [1e12 cm^-2], lowest well-sampled B: run 6 is 50 mT-coarse below 1 T)
I_FS = 50e-6                                 # sr1 sensitivity both runs (5 kOhm FS at 10 nA)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 7.5))
for k, (rid, n12, b_ok) in enumerate(SPOTS):
    r = run(rid)
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / -1e6; R = r.col("sr1_X") / I   # device-card channel arithmetic
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I = B[o], R[o], I[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(n12 * 1e16))
    # raw first
    ax[0, k].plot(B, R, lw=0.7)
    ax[0, k].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="R = V_sr1 / I_sr0 (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} raw: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    # onset (well-sampled record only) + FFT
    m = B >= b_ok
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as wl:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        on = sdh_onset(R[m], B[m], b_lo=b_ok, r_full_scale=I_FS / np.median(I))
    print(f"--- run {rid}  n = {n12:+.1f}e12  F_L = {FL:.1f} T  (model ABAB {MODEL[n12]['ABAB']}, ABCA {MODEL[n12]['ABCA']})")
    print(on.summary())
    for w in wl:
        print("   warn:", str(w.message)[:160])
    for lo in ((1.3, 2.0) if n12 > 0 else (0.7, 1.5)):
        f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, B.max()), bg_degree=5, nfft=4096)
        sp = s[0] / s[0][f > 2].max()
        ax[1, k].plot(f, sp, lw=0.8, label=f"B = {lo}-10 T")
    ax[1, k].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L (scale 1) {FL:.1f} T")
    for fm in MODEL[n12]["ABAB"]:
        ax[1, k].axvline(fm, color="r", ls=":", lw=1)
    ax[1, k].set(xlim=(0, 2.2 * FL if n12 > 0 else 3 * FL), ylim=(0, 1.1), xlabel="F (T)",
                 title="FFT in 1/B (deg-5 B-space bg); red: ABAB model pair")
    ax[1, k].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

**Read — electron (run 6, n = +3.2):**
- The dominant tone is at **29.4–30.0 T**, i.e. 0.90·F_L at scale 1 (F_L = 33.1 T). Its companions are **22.3 T** and **7.3 T**. These two sum to 29.6 T, the dominant tone.
- Above ~3 T there is a harmonic comb reaching **130 T** (onsets 3.8 / 5.3 / 5.6 T for 59 / 88 / 130 T). The highest frequency present grows roughly as 23·B.
- **Onset:** the fast tones die out at ~1.15–1.2 T (windowed amplitude; `sdh_onset` 5σ gives 1.4 T for 22.3 T and 1.8 T for 29.4 T). The 7.3 T component is weak at low B: amp/noise ≈ 2 at 1.4 T. It is censored at the 1.0 T record edge and not tracked by `sdh_onset`.

Two readings survive one density:
- **(a) ABAB:** the pair (7.3, 22.3) plus a breakdown sum tone at 29.6 T, which is symmetry-allowed in 4L. This needs a global scale ≈ 0.90.
- **(b) Singleton:** one tone at ≈ F_L (scale 0.90), with 22.3 / 7.3 as comb or intermodulation products (≈ ¾ and ¼ of it).

`sdh_onset` labels every tone a harmonic of 7.3 T. The Luttinger-aware screen forbids settling that by ratio. **The discriminator is the n-dependence:** a harmonic tracks k·f exactly, while an ABAB heavy/sum pair drifts in ratio (model heavy/F_L 0.78 → 0.84 from n = 3.2 → 1.8). That comparison is the fan.

**Read — hole (run 7, n = −1.2):**
- This is the cleaner record by onset: **0.71 T** (6.6 T tone, SNR 84).
- Tones: 4.7–5.3, 6.6–7.0 and **12.3 T ≈ F_L at scale 1**.
- This sits in the near-CNP exception regime: the model ABAB pair is 5.9 / 6.5 T, close and balanced. A real ABCA pocket here would carry m* ≈ 1 mₑ and be LK-dead at T_e ≈ 8 K. So a 12.3 T tone with a 1.6 T onset points toward a sum tone, not an ABCA pocket. **Not a call.**

**Hedges:**
- The two sides imply different scales, 0.90 (e) vs ≈ 1.0 (h). This stays open until the global scale is fitted on the whole peak set.
- The electron trace dips negative at 6 T (−30 Ω): B_1–B_2 picks up some Rxy. Frequencies are unaffected, but with +B only there is no symmetrization.

**Side choice → the fan goes to the electron side.** Only the electron side reaches the design densities |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² on the D = 0 line inside the validators. The hole side stops at −1.27, inside the exception regime.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`, per `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4)

> **05:29** · landau-fan-vti e-side D=0: n +1.80..+3.25e12 (32 pts, dn 0.047) x B 1.0->10 T (155 rows: 1/B-uniform 0.0099 to 1.62 T, then dB/B 1.6%), fast 2.1 s, sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~10:24** (≈4h55m)

**What it decides.** Spot check run 6 (n = +3.2) returned {7.3, 22.3, 29.6 T}, with 7.3 + 22.3 = 29.6 ≈ 0.90·F_L. From one density that set fits two readings (ana, runs 6 + 7):
- an ABAB pair plus a breakdown sum tone;
- a singleton plus comb/intermodulation products.

The fan measures the **n-dependence** of each tone across n = +1.80 … +3.25×10¹². A harmonic tracks k·f exactly. An ABAB pair drifts in ratio (model heavy/F_L 0.78 → 0.84) and sums to F_L at every column. The same object pins the global scale, and gives the B-window split for the F_L-tone origin.

**Side and coverage.** Electron side only. It is the only side whose D = 0 line reaches the design densities |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² inside the validators (top point n = 3.25 → V_tg = 0.998 V against the 1.0 V limit). The hole side is cleaner by onset (0.71 T vs ~1.2 T), but its D = 0 reach ends at −1.27, inside the exception regime. **Excluded:** a hole fan (−1.27…−0.6, ≈ 2 h), deferred. **Low edge n = 1.8:** below it the heavy tone and F_L converge within δF. At the low-n end ν = 8 / 12 / 16 fall inside 10 T, which gives the Step-6 layer-number check.

**Design (landau-fan step 1, checks computed):**
- **B_lo = 1.0 T.** This is `sdh_onset` on run 6's well-sampled record. It is censored at the record edge by the weak 7.3 T tone; the fast tones die out at ~1.15–1.2 T. The partner at ≥ 5 periods holds for n ≳ 2.7 at scale 1.
- **B_hi = 10 T.** The B-window split needs the high-field half, and ν = 8 at the low-n end needs it too. The fan ends where the next step (LK ladder / firming fan riding down) starts.
- **B grid — deliberately not `field_invB`.** Uniform 1/B at 0.0099 T⁻¹ (⅓-Nyquist on F_L(3.25) = 33.6 T) up to 1.62 T, then geometric at ΔB/B = 1.6 %, so the local Nyquist is 31·B. Run 6's harmonic comb reaches ~23·B (130 T at 5.6 T). A uniform 1/B grid at the F_L rule would alias 81–130 T onto 20–29 T, exactly the tones under test. Resolution: δF ≈ 1.1 T on the record above 1 T.
- **n axis:** 32 pts, Δn = 0.047 ≤ 0.048, the ray-Nyquist floor (2 pts/ray at 1.0 T).
- **Dwell:** fast_delay 2.1 s = 7τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB; the per-column read carries the signal).
- **Sensitivity:** sr1 fixed at 50 µV = 5 kΩ FS. The worst corner (n = 1.8, 10 T) is estimated at ~1.5 kΩ ≈ 30 % FS; a per-row RAIL WARN prints if |X| > 0.9 FS.
- **Price:** 155 rows × (32 × 2.25 s + 7 s turnaround) ≈ 3 h 25 m, plus 10 T of blocking ramp ≈ 1 h 13 m. About 4 h 40 m, headline 4 h 55 m with the session's ~5 % over-run.

**Guards and checkpoints.** Preconditions: base T, B ≈ 0, Si 0, heaters off, drive / τ unchanged. Leak trip at 1 nA on either gate interrupts. Checkpoints:
- **First rows (~10 min):** signal level vs run 6 at 1 T (≈ 13 Ω at n = 3.2), gate currents, T.
- **~2.5 T (~1 h 45 m):** SdH present across columns.
- **~4.5 T (~3 h):** partial per-column FFT on 1–4.5 T. Do the 22 / 30 T tones disperse with n, and do they track k·f or the Onsager curves? If there is no tone content, abandon.
- **~7 T:** rail check at the low-n corner.

**End state:** B = 10 T, gates on the D = 0 line at n = 3.25.

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`): n +1.80 -> +3.25e12 (32 pts) x B 1.0 -> 10 T (155 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_LO, N_HI, N_N, D0 = 1.80, 3.25, 32, 0.0          # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm; dn = 0.0468 <= ray-Nyquist floor 0.048 at B_lo = 1.0 T
ns = np.linspace(N_LO, N_HI, N_N)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, D0 * np.ones_like(ns), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs), np.asarray(Vbgs)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs, Vbgs)
_n_chk, _D_chk = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
print(f"n-line: {N_N} pts, n {ns[0]:+.3f} -> {ns[-1]:+.3f}e12 (dn {ns[1]-ns[0]:.4f}), D = {D0}; "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f}; roundtrip |D|max {np.max(np.abs(_D_chk)):.1e}")

# --- field grid: uniform 1/B at 0.0099 T^-1 (Nyquist 1/3 on F_L(3.25) = 33.6 T) from 1.0 T up to 1.616 T,
#     then geometric at dB/B = 1.6 % (local F_Nyquist = 31*B) to 10 T. The geometric leg follows the run-6
#     harmonic comb, whose highest frequency grows ~23*B (130 T at 5.6 T). A plain field_invB at 0.0099 would
#     fold 81-130 T onto 20-29 T, right on the tones under test.
B_LO, B_HI, DINV_LO, R_STEP = 1.0, 10.0, 0.0099, 0.016
B_X = R_STEP / DINV_LO
_seg1 = 1.0 / np.arange(1 / B_LO, 1 / B_X, -DINV_LO)
_seg2 = np.geomspace(B_X, B_HI, int(np.ceil(np.log(B_HI / B_X) / np.log(1 + R_STEP))) + 1)
B_vec = np.round(np.concatenate([_seg1, _seg2]), 4)
assert np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0) and B_vec.min() >= B_LO - 1e-9 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} rows, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; max d(1/B) {np.max(-np.diff(1 / B_vec)):.4f} 1/T; "
      f"grid = {len(B_vec)} x {N_N} = {len(B_vec) * N_N} pts")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05: rig handed back at 0 T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} K off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not at 0 T: {_B0}"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0, "a heater is on"
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
_f, _a = sr1.frequency(), sr1.amplitude()
assert abs(_f - 13.777) < 0.01 and abs(_a - 1.0) < 1e-6, (_f, _a)
print(f"drive {_a} V @ {_f} Hz -> I_bias 10 nA; tau sr1 {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB, sr0 {sr0.time_constant()} s")
assert sr1.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr0.time_constant() == 0.3, "tau changed since bring-up: re-price fast_delay"

# --- lock-in: fixed for the whole fan (no autorange). 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA, same as spot checks 6/7.
#     Worst corner n = 1.8 x 10 T: R(n=1.8, 0 T) = 77 Ohm (run 5) x ~20 (2x the run-6 MR peak factor 9.5) ~ 1.5 kOhm -> 30 % FS.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
SENS = sr1.sensitivity()
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.1, 3.0     # 7 tau at 0.3 s / 24 dB (residual ~8 %); slow_delay covers flyback settle
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"sr1 sens {SENS} V, sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron D=0: n {N_LO:+.2f}..{N_HI:+.2f}e12 ({N_N}), B {B_LO}..{B_HI} T ({len(B_vec)} rows: "
                  f"1/B-uniform {DINV_LO} to {B_X:.3f} T, then dB/B {R_STEP}), sr1 50 uV, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = {D0} V/nm, n = {N_LO:+.2f} to {N_HI:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} pts), B = {B_LO} to {B_HI} T '
              f'({len(B_vec)} rows; uniform 1/B at {DINV_LO} 1/T to {B_X:.3f} T, geometric dB/B = {R_STEP} above); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'stacking FS-count fan (tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4), follows spot checks runs 6/7')

# gates to the first n-point, then the first slow set ramps 0 -> 1.0 T (blocking, ~7.5 min) inside the sweep
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbgs[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtgs[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

_rail_rows = set()
def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    x = abs(float(data[9]))
    if x > 0.9 * SENS and float(data[1]) not in _rail_rows:          # warn once per row; the agent decides at checkpoints
        _rail_rows.add(float(data[1]))
        print(f"RAIL WARN sr1 |X| = {x:.3e} V ({x / SENS:.2f} FS) at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}")
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                 slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# field stays at 10 T (the next step, LK ladder / firming fan, starts there and rides down); gates stay on the D = 0 line.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K; "
      f"rail-warned rows: {len(_rail_rows)}")

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).

from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm

assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B (blocking rate-limited magnet). 50 mT to 1 T (background only), 10 mT 1 -> 10 T:
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.0, 1.0, 0.05), np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.01))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 70 Ohm = 1.4 % FS; MR + SdH maxima at high B size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0 -> 10 T, 10 mT above 1 T, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0 -> 10 T uniform-B (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 10 T (the hole-side spot check rides it down) — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
